name: PCOS Screening Workflow
description: Structured conversation for PCOS assessment with diet and test recommendations

message.en: From what you've said, I'd like to understand a little more about your cycle and some changes you may have noticed. It's all private, and we'll go at your pace. Okay to start?
message.hi: Aapne jo bataya uske anusar, main aapke periods aur kuch changes ke baare mein jaanna chahti hoon. Sab private rahega, aur hum aapki speed se chalenge. Shuru karein?

text.en: Let's start with your periods — do they come every month, or do they skip or come late?
text.hi: Chaliye aapke periods se shuru karte hain — kya har mahine aate hain, ya skip hote hain ya late aate hain?

text.en: Roughly how often — every couple of months, or longer gaps?
text.hi: Lagbhag kitne time mein — har 2-3 mahine mein, ya zyada gap?

text.en: When did you last have one?
text.hi: Aakhri baar kab aaye the?

text.en: Have you gained weight lately, especially around your middle, that's hard to shift?
text.hi: Kya aapka weight badha hai, khaas kar pet ke aas-paas, jo kam nahi ho raha?

text.en: Has it been recent, or building up over a year or two?
text.hi: Kya yeh haal hi mein hua hai, ya 1-2 saal se ho raha hai?

text.en: Have you noticed extra hair growing where you'd rather not — on your face, chin, or body?
text.hi: Kya aapko face, chin ya body pe extra baal aane lage hain jahan nahi hone chahiye?

text.en: Is that new, or has it slowly increased?
text.hi: Kya yeh naya hai, ya dheere-dheere badh raha hai?

text.en: How's your skin — do you get acne or oily skin that keeps coming back?
text.hi: Aapki skin kaisi hai — acne ya oily skin wapas aati rehti hai?

text.en: Mostly around your jaw and chin, or all over?
text.hi: Zyada tar jaw aur chin pe, ya puri face pe?

text.en: And the hair on your head — is it thinning or falling more than usual?
text.hi: Aur sir ke baal — kya patli ho rahi hain ya zyada gir rahi hain?

text.en: Have you noticed any dark, velvety patches of skin — maybe on your neck or underarms?
text.hi: Kya aapne skin pe kaale, velvety patches dekhe hain — gardan ya underarms pe?

text.en: How's your energy through the day — do you feel drained or get strong sugar cravings, especially after meals?
text.hi: Din bhar aapki energy kaisi rehti hai — kamzori mehsoos hoti hai ya meetha khaane ka mann karta hai khaas kar khane ke baad?

text.en: A few of these can also come from the thyroid, so let me check — do you often feel unusually cold or tired, or noticed any swelling in your neck?
text.hi: Ye symptoms thyroid se bhi ho sakte hain — kya aapko bahut thandi lagti hai, ya bahut thakan hoti hai, ya gardan mein swelling hai?

text.en: Can you feel it when you swallow, or did someone point it out?
text.hi: Kya aap usko feel kar sakte hain jab aap nigalte hain, ya kisi ne bataya?

text.en: Can you feel it when you swallow, or did someone point it out?
text.hi: Kya aap usko feel kar sakte hain jab aap nigalte hain, ya kisi ne bataya?

text.en: Does anyone in your family have PCOS, thyroid trouble, or diabetes?
text.hi: Kya aapke ghar mein kisi ko PCOS, thyroid ya diabetes hai?

intro.en: Now a little about your food...
intro.hi: Ab thoda aapke khane ke baare mein...

text.en: Are you mostly vegetarian, or do you eat eggs, chicken, fish too?
text.hi: Kya aap vegetarian hain, ya anda, chicken, machhli khaate hain?

text.en: On a usual day, do you eat regular meals, or do they get skipped or rushed?
text.hi: Aam din mein aap regular khana khaate hain, ya skip hota hai ya jaldi-jaldi khaate hain?

text.en: Which one usually gets missed?
text.hi: Kaunsa meal usually miss hota hai?

text.en: Which one usually gets missed?
text.hi: Kaunsa meal usually miss hota hai?

text.en: What does your plate usually look like — mostly rice or roti, with dal or vegetables?
text.hi: Aapki plate mein usually kya hota hai — zyada chawal ya roti, dal ya sabzi?

text.en: Do you take a lot of sweets, sugary tea, or cold drinks through the day?
text.hi: Kya aap din mein bahut meetha, cheeni wali chai ya cold drinks lete hain?

text.en: Is it more a daily habit, or mostly on occasions?
text.hi: Kya yeh roz ki aadat hai, ya khaas occasions pe?

text.en: And fried or outside food — how often in a week?
text.hi: Aur fried ya bahar ka khana — hafte mein kitni baar?

intro.en: Thank you for being open with me. Now let's do a few quick checks — your height and weight, blood pressure, and a small blood test. Aasha didi will help, no hurry.
intro.hi: Dhanyavaad. Ab kuch quick checks karte hain — height, weight, BP aur blood test. ASHA didi help karengi, koi jaldi nahi.

consentMessage.en: First, let's check your height and weight — just step on the scale please.
consentMessage.hi: Pehle height aur weight check karte hain — bas scale pe khade ho jaiye.

consentMessage.en: I'd like to take your blood pressure — just a cuff on your arm for 30 seconds. Shall we?
consentMessage.hi: BP check karna hai — bas arm pe cuff lagega 30 second ke liye. Karein?

consentMessage.en: Let me check your blood sugar now — a tiny prick on your fingertip. May I go ahead?
consentMessage.hi: Ab blood sugar check karte hain — ungli pe chhoti si chubhan hogi. Karein?

consentMessage.en: Now I'd like to check your haemoglobin — it's just a tiny prick on your fingertip, takes a minute. Aasha didi will do it for you, no hurry. Shall we do it now?
consentMessage.hi: Ab hemoglobin check karna hai — ungli pe chhoti si chubhan, ek minute lagega. ASHA didi karegi, koi jaldi nahi. Karein?

consentMessage.en: Since thyroid symptoms came up, I'd like to do a thyroid test too — another small blood sample. Okay?
consentMessage.hi: Kyunki thyroid ke symptoms the, thyroid test bhi karna hai — ek aur chhota blood sample. Thik hai?

message.en: Once we're done I'll put it together in simple words and we'll talk about the next step. PCOS is very manageable once we understand it.
message.hi: Jab sab ho jayega, main simple shabdon mein samjhaaungi aur next step discuss karenge. PCOS manageable hai jab hum isse samajh lete hain.

advice.en: Don't skip meals, especially breakfast — it helps control sugar cravings and balances hormones.
advice.hi: Khana skip mat kijiye, khaas kar breakfast — yeh sugar cravings control karta hai aur hormones balance karta hai.

advice.en: Reduce sugary tea, cold drinks, and sweets — PCOS makes your body sensitive to sugar spikes.
advice.hi: Meethi chai, cold drinks aur mithai kam karein — PCOS mein body sugar ke liye sensitive hoti hai.

advice.en: Add protein to every meal — dal, sprouts, paneer. Protein slows sugar absorption.
advice.hi: Har meal mein protein add karein — dal, ankurit anaj, paneer. Protein sugar absorption slow karta hai.

advice.en: Cut down fried and outside food — aim for 2-3 times a week maximum instead of daily.
advice.hi: Fried aur bahar ka khana kam karein — hafte mein maximum 2-3 baar, daily nahi.

general.en: Fill half your plate with vegetables — they help manage weight and insulin.
general.hi: Apni plate ka aadha hissa sabziyon se bharein — weight aur insulin manage karne mein help hota hai.

general.en: Choose whole grains over refined — brown rice, millets, whole wheat.
general.hi: Refined ki jagah whole grains lein — brown rice, millets, gehoon ka atta.

general.en: Drink 2-3 litres of water daily for hormone balance.
general.hi: Hormone balance ke liye roz 2-3 litre paani piyein.
